# MathJax
**Category:** [Math, Physics & Interactive Science](../)
**Ecosystem:** [JavaScript Visualization, Graphical, & Interactive Libraries](../../)

## Overview
Beautiful, accessible math typesetting in all browsers supporting LaTeX, MathML, and AsciiMath.

## Official Resources
- **Website / Documentation:** [https://www.mathjax.org](https://www.mathjax.org)

## Installation & Setup
```bash
npm install mathjax
```

### CDN Embed:
```html
<script id="MathJax-script" async src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3/es5/tex-mml-chtml.js"></script>
```

## Starter / Hello World Example
```html
<p>When \(a \ne 0\), there are two solutions to \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\) and they are</p>
<p>$$x = {-b \pm \sqrt{b^2-4ac} \over 2a}.$$</p>
```
